Title: Question about the new preview setite.

Messages.Author: Klai...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
If he attempts an action, someone attempts to block, and he plays
Venenation, is the block cancelled since the blocking minion can't
block him anymore due to having corruption counter?

Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:


I would say they still do block. This is because, from card text,
Venenation can only be played AFTER a minion has blocked. The
vampire's card text says vampires cannot attempt to block him. The
vampire has already attempted and successfully blocked; before combat
begins, he plays Venenation, then you go to combat.

Unless of course you Change of Target after the Venenation but before
combat, which you can legally do... wow that is super, super evil.
Play that new Revelation of Ecstasy card to tap and corrupt one guy.
Then untap and try and call a vote, they block with another dude; play
Venenation, Change of Target, then bleed for lots. They can't block
you.

I'm thinking there's probably also some hideously evil stuff that can
be done with this vampire and Mask1KFaces?
Big scary dude corrupts prey's minions, then bleeds. They decline to
block. Then weenie setite plays Mask and jumps in on the bleed. Then
big scary dude actually bleeds. Is that legal?
